children: Silver Bow Mining amended and issued performance warrants for Chief Executive Officer C. Travis Naugle, with amended milestones enabling vesting of 200,000 warrants and a new 2,000,000‑warrant grant subject to NYSE American and shareholder approval.
Amendment to existing performance warrants; Issuance of new performance warrants
Amendments approved Oct 14, 2026; Montana Tunnels Milestones deemed achieved Oct 2, 2026; New grant approved Oct 14, 2026 (grant date subject to shareholder/NYS E American approval)
Board replaced PEA Milestone due to pending acquisition of Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex and entry into term sheet with Ocean Partners UK Limited
200,000 previously tied to PEA Milestone will vest upon NYSE American approval; New 2,000,000 warrants vest upon specified resource, market cap, and production milestones
Existing Performance Warrants (Jan 28, 2025) cover 1,400,000 shares (1,200,000 vested); new warrants cover 2,000,000 shares with tiered milestones and specified exercise prices
